reported_symptom: An add-on developer reported that switching the controlled Zoi around scene start crashed or disabled their integration, prevented further API starts and removed the manual starter.
method: Retail Live Mode with four household Zois. A temporary independently mounted B2 client used the public SDK and public messages. Possession changes used the native game command. No framework or HZoi code was replaced.

native_checks.during_playback: A framework standing session kept playing after switching to the partner and then to a nearby nonparticipant. Its original SDK client retained access and stopped it. A fresh request from the new controlled Zoi started another scene, which also survived switching to its partner.
native_checks.stale_initiator: A start using the previous controlled Zoi as initiator returned initiator_not_controlled. The next valid start succeeded.
native_checks.pending_start: Switching after API acceptance and before playback produced session_start_failed with start_failed and a terminal failed request status. A new start from the newly controlled Zoi succeeded immediately.
native_checks.authored_actions: The three directed action records from HZoi's Standing Rear Sex declaration yielded one find_scenes result. start_random_scene with only the criteria reached the matched scene. It stayed active after switching to the partner and a nearby nonparticipant. A subsequent start_scene using the ID returned by find_scenes also reached playback with the female participant as the controlled initiator.
native_checks.cleanup: All tested completed sessions emitted session_ended with cleanup_complete. Native readback after the last API session showed idle/ok, gameplay input restored and autosave released. The temporary SDK probe was unmounted and archived outside Mods.

manual_acceptance: After remounting only the UI, the launcher acknowledgement and host token stayed stable through an action-based start, two possession changes and API Exit. The maintainer then opened the manual picker, started playback and exited. Native selection and Exit records confirm the run.
limits: The reported add-on's code and logs were unavailable. The local probe used independent SDK clients for each caller entity and a fixed loaded household. Native mod startup and distant spectator exit were outside this check.
hot_reload_control: The first probe unmount restarted the host and temporarily left its B1 actor registry empty, so a manual Start failed before selection. A separate Lua-only reload reset selection_launcher_ready to none while leaving the UI boot token unchanged. That result was reproduced with the probe removed and before any API request in the new host. A full Lua reload followed by a UI remount restored both readiness acknowledgements. See the development guide for the sequence.
